ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: This question asks where one can escape the paired physical conditions of heat and cold.
EvidenceBody: Jiashan Shanhui’s case answers by directing the questioner into the extremity of heat and cold themselves; Yuanwu Keqin later cites that exchange rather than offering a climate-controlled refuge. The phrase is the question’s exact demand, not permission to replace its concrete weather with an abstract opposition.
